notes.title: Orca Funtime update
notes.content:
Today's update fixes some resource management issues, so it should run even better now than it did before. I'm working on getting everything running smooth even with the graphics cranked up, but for now, it's all turned down to ensure that it runs on all machines.

There was a problem with some of the boats getting stuck, and that has all been fixed. Also, now the other orcas in your pod will move and stay with you, instead of running off or diving and leaving the pod after a few moments.

The ocean has had some major repairs, as well. I added waves that were supposed to be in this update, but the ocean repairs ruined the buoyancy of the orca which made the player fly around in the air on occasion. So, until that's fixed, I have turned the waves off. It will be coming soon.

There are some more people added now, and more will be coming in the next update. The blood, which also was supposed to be in this update, didn't work out so well, so I'll try to fix that. 

Outside of waves, the next update will include more people on the boats, a new attack, and hopefully all that good blood. After that, there will also be levels to choose from and the beginning of the storyline. I will only be releasing the first part of the story until the rest of it is done and ready to go, but the sandbox will stay in place. I've had some people ask about gameplay and controls, so I will also work on adding a short tutorial to help out with that.

Go get them boats!
